build_quantizer_residual_vq: build a Quantizer with ResidualVQ codebook using code_dim, codebook_num, and codebook_size parameters
run_quantizer_forward: run the Quantizer forward pass on latent tensor z to get quantized output, VQ loss, and perplexity
run_quantizer_inference: run the Quantizer inference method on latent tensor z to get quantized output and discrete indices
run_quantizer_encode: run the Quantizer encode method on latent tensor z to get quantized output and flattened indices
run_quantizer_decode: run the Quantizer decode method on discrete indices to reconstruct the original latent tensor
